https://www.inquirer.net/494956/comelec-.summary_zh: 阅读：最高法院支持延长barangay和地方议会官员任期的法律；选举委员会主席George Erwin Garcia说，这项裁决已经解决了围绕该法律合法性的疑问。Garcia说：“尽管最高法院的裁决并非一致通过，但最高法院的决定已经成为国家法律的一部分所形成的判例法。”Garcia此前曾形容，在同一年举行全国和地方选举以及BSKE对委员会而言“任务繁重”，因为两项选举活动都需要大量筹备工作。
https://www.inquirer.net/494956/comelec-.body: In a statement, the poll body welcomed the high court’s decision dismissing a petition filed by election lawyer Romulo Macalintal challenging Republic Act No. 12326. READ: SC upholds law extending barangay, SK officials’ terms Comelec Chair George Erwin Garcia said the ruling had settled questions surrounding the legality of the law.“Although not unanimous, the SC decision is already a jurisprudence forming part of the law of the land,” Garcia said. Garcia had earlier described holding the national and local elections and the BSKE in the same year as “heavy” for the commission, given the preparations needed for both electoral exercises. READ: 2026 BSKE preparations canceled following postponement law — Comelec President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed RA 12326 on Sept. 24, moving the BSKE, originally scheduled for Nov. 2, 2026, to the second Monday of November 2028, or Nov. 13. The law also extended the terms of barangay and SK officials from four to five years. It limits barangay officials to two consecutive terms in the same position and SK officials to one term. Macalintal filed a petition for certiorari and prohibition before the Supreme Court on Sept. 27, arguing that the law effectively prolonged the terms of incumbent officials by postponing the elections without sufficient justification. But in the decision promulgated on Oct. 14 and made public on Friday, the high court ruled that RA 12326 primarily fixes the terms of barangay and SK officials rather than postponing elections. The SC stressed that setting the next Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) in November 2028 merely implements the new five-year term. It said this does not make the law an election postponement measure simply because it affects the polling schedule. It also ruled that the guidelines on election postponements established in its 2023 decision in an earlier Macalintal case do not apply to RA 12326. The high court further maintained that the law does not violate the constitutional right to suffrage, noting that the right to vote does not require a specific election frequency or term length for barangay and SK officials. https://www.inquirer.net/494956/comelec-.title_zh: 最高法院就BSKE案作出裁决后，尼日利亚联邦选举委员会将目光转向2028年5月选举
https://www.inquirer.net/494956/comelec-.body_zh: 在一份声明中，选举机构欢迎高等法院驳回选举律师Romulo Macalintal针对《共和国法案》第12326号提出的上诉。阅读：最高法院维持了延长描 Barangay 和 SK 官员任期的法律——Comelec主席George Erwin Garcia表示，这项裁决已经解决了围绕该法律合法性的所有疑问。Garcia说：“尽管最高法院的裁决并非一致通过，但该裁决已经成为法理，并成为国家法律的一部分。”此前，Garcia曾形容，在同一年举行全国和地方选举以及 BSKE 对选举委员会而言“负担沉重”，因为两项选举活动都需要进行大量筹备工作。阅读：依据推迟选举的法律，2026年 BSKE 筹备工作被取消——菲律宾总统Ferdinand Marcos Jr.于9月24日签署了第12326号共和国法案，将原定于2026年11月2日举行的 BSKE 推迟至2028年11月的第二个星期一，即11月13日。该法律还将描 Barangay 和 SK 官员的任期从4年延长至5年，并规定描 Barangay 官员在同一职位上连续任职不得超过两届，SK 官员不得超过一届。Macalintal于9月27日向最高法院申请调卷令和禁令令，主张该法律实际上通过推迟选举延长了现任官员的任期，却没有充分理由。不过，在10月14日公布并于周五对外公开的裁决中，高等法院认定，第12326号共和国法案主要是在确定描 Barangay 和 SK 官员的任期，而非推迟选举。最高法院强调，将下一轮描 Barangay 和青年议会议员选举（BSKE）定于2028年11月，只是在落实新的5年任期。最高法院表示，仅仅因为该法律影响到投票日程，并不会使其成为推迟选举的措施。最高法院还裁定，在此前 Macalintal 案件中于2023年判决中确立的推迟选举指导原则，不适用于第12326号共和国法案。高等法院进一步认为，该法律并未侵犯宪法规定的选举权，并指出，投票权并不意味着必须为描 Barangay 和 SK 官员规定特定的选举频率或任期长度。与此同时，Comelec计划于11月10日恢复全国选民登记，申请期将持续至2027年7月30日。您的订阅无法保存，请重试。您的订阅已成功保存。选举机构计划在为期9个月的登记期内新增300万名登记选民，使全国选民人数从目前的7100万增加到约7400万，以迎接2028年5月的选举。/jpv

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110703.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 박수윤 권희원 노선웅 기자 = 12·3 비상계엄 사태 2년이 8일로 20여일 앞으로 다가오면서 국민의힘 내에서 대국민 사과 문제를 놓고 계파별로 다른 목소리가 나오고 있다. 오세훈 서울시장의 항소심 생환을 계기로 보수 야권 내에서 대통합 문제가 화두로 떠오른 가운데 윤석열 전 대통령에 대한 탄핵 문제와 맞물린 '계엄 사과' 문제가 부각될 될 경우 내홍이 재점화할 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 그는 지난 6일 매일신문 유튜브 채널에서 '계엄 사과' 문제에 "지지층만 분열시키고 민생과는 아무 관계 없는 일로, 지지율 하락으로 이어진다"면서 "그걸 보면서도 이런 문제에 때만 되면 천착하는 분들은 의도적으로 지도부를 흔들기 위한 (목적) 아니면 당을 갈라치기 하려는 것"이라고 말했다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110703.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）박수윤、권희원、노선웅记者＝随着“12·3紧急戒严事件”两周年的纪念日8日还有20多天到来，党内围绕是否应向全体国民道歉的问题出现不同声音。继吴世勋首尔市长撤诉案获法院改判无罪后，保守派在野阵营内部的团结问题成为焦点；如果“戒严道歉”问题与前总统尹锡悦的弹劾问题交织并受到关注，国内局势可能再次出现严重对立。某议员6日在《每日新闻》YouTube频道谈及“戒严道歉”问题时表示：“这件事只会分裂支持层，与民生毫无关系，最终导致支持率下降。明明看到了这一点，每当出现这种问题时，那些天真的议员要么是故意想动摇政府，要么是想分裂政党。”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110703.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 박수윤 권희원 노선웅 기자 = 12·3 비상계엄 사태 2년이 8일로 20여일 앞으로 다가오면서 국민의힘 내에서 대국민 사과 문제를 놓고 계파별로 다른 목소리가 나오고 있다. 오세훈 서울시장의 항소심 생환을 계기로 보수 야권 내에서 대통합 문제가 화두로 떠오른 가운데 윤석열 전 대통령에 대한 탄핵 문제와 맞물린 '계엄 사과' 문제가 부각될 될 경우 내홍이 재점화할 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 그는 지난 6일 매일신문 유튜브 채널에서 '계엄 사과' 문제에 "지지층만 분열시키고 민생과는 아무 관계 없는 일로, 지지율 하락으로 이어진다"면서 "그걸 보면서도 이런 문제에 때만 되면 천착하는 분들은 의도적으로 지도부를 흔들기 위한 (목적) 아니면 당을 갈라치기 하려는 것"이라고 말했다. 이는 사실상 계엄 사과가 당에 유해할 뿐만 아니라 계엄 사과 요구가 정파적 목적에 따른 것이란 인식으로 분석된다. 당권파 신동욱 최고위원과 이진숙 의원도 각각 언론 인터뷰에서 "매년 이렇게 하는 건 적절치 않다. 올해 하면 내년 원내대표도 해야 하나", "해마다 12월 3일이 되면 마치 기념일 지키듯 사과해서는 안 된다"고 언급했다. 한 중진 의원은 연합뉴스와 만나 "사과하라면 할 수 있다. 그런데 당원들, 특히 대구의 경우 이걸로 왜 또 당에서 서로 싸우냐는 분위기가 많다. 언론에서 계속 사과 안 하냐고 분위기를 몰아가는 것도 있다"며 한숨을 쉬었다. 한 초선 의원은 "계엄에 대해선 몇번이고 사과해야 한다고 생각하지만 '내란'이라는 주장에는 동의하지 않는다"면서 윤 전 대통령에 대한 탄핵이 섣불리 진행됐다는 주장을 폈다. 오 시장은 지난 3일 국회에서 기자들과 만나 "국민 마음에 다가가기 위한 모든 노력을 아끼지 말아야 한다"면서 "국민께서 국민의힘에 실망하신 점이 있다면 그에 대해 분명하게 입장을 정리하고, 두 번이 됐든 다섯 번이 됐든 (사과) 못 할 일이 없다"고 강조했다. 한 친한(친한동훈)계 의원은 사견을 전제로 "국민들께서 받아들이실 때까지 사과해야 한다"면서 "'왜 자꾸 사과를 반복하느냐'고 말하는 분들이 계시는데, 우리 당이 정말 진정성 있게 사과한 적이 있나. 당 대표라는 사람이 계엄 1년에도 이상한 소리를 하지 않았느냐"고 반문했다. 당내 비주류 모임 '대안과 미래' 간사인 이성권 의원은 지난 6일 MBC 인터뷰에서 "장동혁 대표가 계엄 사과를 요구하는 부분에 대해 '분열을 얘기하는 것'이라고 한 점에 있어서 시대정신에 맞는 지도자이냐는 의문이 있다"고 꼬집었다. 초선 김용태 의원도 MBC에 나와 "당 대표가 저렇게 말씀하시면 자칫 국민들이 국민의힘을 향해 '사과하기 싫은 것 아니냐'는 오해를 하실 수 있다"면서 "12·3 불법 계엄에 대해서는 언제나 국민께 사과하는 마음을 갖는 게 중요하다"고 말했다. 지난해 송언석 당시 원내대표가 사과문을 낸 것과 마찬가지로 원내대표 차원에서 대응할 수도 있다는 이유에서다. 정 원내대표는 일단 모든 것을 원점에 두고 당내 의견을 수렴해 사과 여부를 판단해야 한다는 입장인 것으로 알려졌다. 원내 핵심 관계자는 "정 원내대표는 의원들의 의견을 취합해보고 뭐가 필요하다고 한다면 해야겠다는 생각을 갖고 있다"고 전했다. 이와 관련, 당내에서는 의견 수렴 및 필요성 검토 차원에서 당 싱크탱크인 여의도연구원이 여론조사를 통해 민심과 당심을 확인하는 방안, 의원총회를 열어 의원들의 견해를 공개적으로 수렴하는 방안 등이 아이디어 차원에서 거론되고 있다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110703.body_zh:
（首尔=韩联社）朴秀允、权熙元、卢善雄记者＝距离“12·3”紧急戒严事件发生两周年还有20多天之际，党内围绕是否应通过国民力量党向全体国民道歉的问题出现不同声音。随着吴世勋首尔市长上诉审获释，保守派在野阵营内部的团结问题成为焦点；如果对弹劾前总统尹锡悦的问题与“戒严道歉”问题交织，党内矛盾可能再次激化。

吴世勋6日在《每日新闻》YouTube频道谈及“戒严道歉”问题时表示：“这只会分裂支持层，与民生毫无关系，最终导致支持率下降。”他还说：“即便看到这种情况，每当出现这种问题时仍天真正思考的人，不是为了故意动摇领导层，就是想借此分裂政党。”这实际上意味着，人们认为戒严道歉不仅会给执政党带来危害，要求戒严道歉也是出于政治目的。

执政党方面，权东旭最高委员和李进淑议员分别在媒体采访中表示：“每年都这样不合适，今年道歉的话，明年院内代表是不是也要当代表道歉？”“每年到了12月3日，不能像守纪念日一样反复道歉。”

韩重진议员接受韩联社采访时说：“如果道歉，可以道歉。但是党内，尤其是大邱地区，许多人认为为什么要因为这件事在党内互相争斗。媒体也在持续营造‘为什么还不道歉’的气氛。”他叹了口气。

一位初任议员表示：“关于戒严，我认为无论道歉多少次都理所当然，但并不认同所谓‘内乱’的说法。”他主张，对前总统尹锡悦的弹劾是不加慎重就推进的。

吴世勋市长3日会见记者时强调：“我们不应放弃一切为了接近国民心意所做的努力。 如果国民对国民力量党感到失望，就应明确整理相关立场；无论已经道歉两次还是五次，都没有不能道歉的事。”

一位亲近韩东勋的议员表示，以个人意见为前提，“国民不接受，我们就应一直道歉”，并反问道：“有人说‘为什么总是反复道歉’，但我们党真的曾经真诚地道歉过吗？担任党代表的人，在戒严一周年时不是也说过一些奇怪的话吗？”

党内非主流团体“替代与未来”干事李成权议员6日接受MBC采访时批评说：“党代表要求戒严道歉，并将其说成‘谈分裂’，让人怀疑他是否是符合时代精神的领导者。”

初任议员金勇泰也出现在MBC节目中，说：“党代表如果那样说，国民可能会误以为我们党‘不愿意向国民力量党道歉’。”他强调：“对于‘12·3’非法戒严，始终怀着向国民道歉的心很重要。”由于去年时任院内代表宋彦锡曾发表道歉声明，因此也可以从院内代表层面作出回应。

据了解，院内代表郑镇 Initially 的立场是，首先将一切还原到原点，汇总党内意见后判断是否道歉。党内核心负责人透露：“郑院内代表的想法是，先汇总议员意见，如果认为有必要，就会采取相应行动。”

与此同时，党内正在从意见汇总和必要性研究的角度讨论若干方案，包括通过执政党的智库汝矣研究所进行舆论调查，确认民心与党心；召开议员大会，公开汇总议员意见等。

통한 합법적인 의사진행 방해) 대치가 벌어질 가능성을 배제하기 어려운 상태다. 예결위는 종합정책 질의에 이어 부처별 심사에 착수한다. 실질적인 '칼질'이 이뤄지는 예산소위 활동(16일)을 앞두고 부처·사업별로 예산안의 세부 내용을 살펴보는 것이다. 9∼10일에는 기획예산처, 재정경제부, 산업통상부, 국토교통부 등 경제 부처가, 11∼12일에는 법무부, 통일부, 외교부, 국방부, 행정안전부, 경찰청, 중대범죄수사청, 인사혁신처 등 비경제부처가 대상이다. 올해 예산 심사 전선은 820조9천억원 규모의 내년도 본예산과 함께 162조원 규모의 미래대응기금 등 두 곳에서 펼쳐질 전망이다. 민주당은 내년도 정부 예산을 미래 투자와 민생 안정, 불평등·양극화 완화를 위한 예산이라는 점을 강조하고 있다. 나아가 ▲ 사람·인프라 투자 ▲ 지방 재정 지원 ▲ 민생경제 ▲ 안전 투자 관련 예산은 국회 심사 과정에서 추가로 증액하는 방안도 검토 중이다. 민주당은 미래대응기금에 대해서도 향후 성장동력을 만들기 위한 '미래 선점 예산'이라면서 사수 방침을 밝힌 상태다. 민주당은 예산안은 적시 처리가 중요한 만큼 법정 시한인 다음 달 2일까지는 국회 절차를 완료한다는 방침이다. 한병도 원내대표는 지난 3일 "민생 지원과 미래 투자가 제때 이루어지도록 집권 여당의 책임을 다할 것"이라고 밝혔다. 반면 국민의힘은 내년도 정부 예산안에 대해서는 27조원 규모의 삭감을 주장하고 있으며, 미래대응기금에 대해서는 '신설 불가' 입장을 강조하고 있다. 국민의힘은 우선 정부 예산안에서 재정 정상화를 위해 불요불급한 100대 문제 사업을 중심으로 27조원 이상의 예산을 감액한다는 방침이다. 그 대상은 기본사회·빛의 위원회, 협동조합 지원, 경제인문사회연구회, 청와대 특활비, 중수청 특활비, 신고포상금 등이다. 국민의힘은 추가 세수를 기반으로 신설이 추진되는 미래대응기금을 이재명 대통령의 '쌈짓돈'이자 '2028년 총선용 여당의 사금고'로 규정하고 있다. 정점식 원내대표는 지난 6일 "정부가 일시적인 세수 호황에 기대 국가채무와 국고채 이자 부담을 눈덩이처럼 불려놓는 무책임한 확장 재정을 밀어붙이고 있다"면서 "선심성, 전시성 확장 재정과 기금의 꼼수는 국회 심의 과정에서 반드시 막아내겠다"고 다짐했다. 이런 가운데 미래대응기금 적립액을 지방교부세 산정 기준에서 제외하는 것을 놓고서는 여당 내에서도 지방 재원 감소에 대한 우려가 있어 향후 조정 가능성도 제기된다. 나아가 정부가 국회 의결 없이 기금 주요 지출 금액을 변경할 수 있는 한도를 정부안의 30%에서 일부 낮추는 방안도 여당 내에서는 거론되고 있다. 민주당은 오는 12일과 19일 개최가 예상되는 국회 본회의에서 민주유공자법, '주택공급활성화 3법'(도시정비법·도시재정비촉진법·용산공원법), 방송 관련 법안 등의 처리를 추진할 계획이다. 가급적 국민의힘과 합의를 끌어내 필리버스터 없이 이들 법안을 의결하겠다는 방침이지만, 민주유공자법을 둘러싼 여야 간 이견이 좁혀지지 않고 있어 필리버스터 대결이 재연될 가능성이 있다. 민주당은 국민의힘의 의견을 반영해 법 적용 대상과 지원 혜택을 상당 부분 축소했다고 하나 국민의힘은 여전히 유공자 인정 기준, 지원기구 설치 관련 내용을 문제 삼고 있다. 민주당 원내 관계자는 "민주유공자법은 대상이나 지원 혜택, 범위 등이 다른 기존 유공자에 비해 상당히 축소된 상황인데 국민의힘이 법안 취지 자체를 몰각하는 형태로 제안하고 있어 저희로서는 받아들이기 어렵다"고 말했다. 이에 국민의힘 측은 "민주화운동에 따른 '피해 보상의 대상'을 결정하는 것과 국민이 존경해야 할 영웅으로서 '유공자'를 결정하는 것은 다른 차원의 문제"라면서 "그러나 이 법은 대상자의 기준이 모호해 민주화운동 인정 범위의 과도한 확대와 국민적 공감대 형성이 부족한 사건까지 포함될 수 있다"고 반박했다. 국민의힘 관계자는 "방화로 경찰관이 사망한 동의대 사건, 운동자금 마련을 위해 강도 행각까지 한 남민전(남조선민족해방전선) 사건 등의 관련자까지 민주유공자 심사 대상이 될 수 있다"고 지적했다. 국민의힘은 SNS를 통해 민주유공자법의 문제점을 정리한 카드뉴스 등을 전파하며 본회의 통과 저지를 벼르고 있다. 나아가 민주당이 순연한 조희대 대법원장에 대한 국정조사 카드를 다시 꺼내 들 경우 여야 간 대치가 더 가팔라질 것으로 보인다. 민주당은 애초 5일 국정조사 요구안을 본회의에 보고하고 1~2주 뒤에 이를 처리하려고 했으나 최근 국정조사에 대해 추가 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110703.title_zh: 菲尔伯对决第二轮赛程预告公布，预算攻防战也正式打响……朝野之争趋于激烈
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110703.body_zh: 共同民主党以执政党主导地位通过《操纵起诉特检法（案）》后，正推动国会 plenary会议处理主要争议法案，而国民力量表明了将予以阻止的方针。民主党针对大法院院长赵熙大的国政调查案仍然存在，因此难以排除每次 plenary会议上都会出现拖延战术（通过无限制辩论合法阻碍议事进展）对抗的局面。预算案审查委员会在综合政策质询后，开始对各部委进行审查。在实质性“削减”活动的预算委员会会议（16日）到来之际，将按部委和项目逐一审查预算案明细。9日至10日审查企划预算处、财政经济部、产业通商部、国土交通部等经济部委，11日至12日则审查法务部、统一部、外交部、国防部、行政安全部、警察厅、重大犯罪搜查厅、人事革新处等非经济部委。今年的预算审查战线预计将在两处展开：一是规模为820.9万亿韩元的明年度基本预算，二是规模为162万亿韩元的未来应对基金等。民主党强调，明年度政府预算属于为未来投资、民生稳定以及缓解不平等和两极化而编制的预算。民主党还在研究，在国会审查过程中对相关预算追加增资，包括：▲人员与基础设施投资▲地方财政支持▲民生经济▲安全投资。民主党还表示，未来应对基金属于为创造未来增长动力而进行的“抢占未来预算”，并表明将予以坚守。民主党称，鉴于预算案及时处理至关重要，将确保在法定期限即下月2日前完成国会相关程序。院内代表韩炳斗3日表示：“执政党将尽到责任，确保民生支持和未来投资能够如期落实。”另一方面，国民力量主张将明年度政府预算案削减27万亿韩元，并强调未来应对基金“不得新设”。国民力量首先表示，将在政府预算案中以财政正常化所需的100项问题事业为中心，削减27万亿韩元以上预算。削减对象包括基本社会与光照委员会、合作组合支持、经济人文社会研究会、青瓦台特别活动费、中小企业厅特别活动费、举报奖金等。国民力量将未来应对基金定性为以追加税收为基础、旨在推动新设的基金，是李在明总统的“零花钱”，也是“执政党用于2028年大选的私人金库”。院内代表郑点锡6日表示：“政府妄图依赖短暂的税收繁荣，把国家债务和国库债利息负担堆积成雪球，却仍强推不负责任的扩张财政”，“我们将一定在国会审议过程中阻止这种缺乏先见性、表演性的扩张财政以及基金把戏。”在此背景下，由于将未来应对基金积累额排除在地方交付税计算标准之外会引发地方财源减少的担忧，执政党内部也有人提出今后可能进行调整。此外，执政党内部还在讨论，将政府未经国会决议即可变更基金主要支出金额的上限，从政府方案中的30%适度下调。民主党计划在预计于12日和19日举行的国会 plenary会议上，推动处理《民主功勋者法》、激活住房供给“三法”（城市整备法、城市整备促进法、梨泰院公园法）、广播相关法案等。民主党方针是尽可能争取国民力量达成共识，在不进行拖延战术的情况下通过这些法案，但围绕民主功勋者法的朝野分歧尚未缩小，因此拖延战术对抗可能再次上演。民主党称，已在相当程度上反映国民力量的意见，缩小法律适用对象和支持优惠，但国民力量仍对功勋者认定标准及设立支援机构等内容提出问题。民主党院内有关负责人表示：“《民主功勋者法》无论适用对象、支持优惠还是范围，都较其他既有功勋者大幅缩减，但国民力量提出的方案从根本上抹杀了该法案的宗旨，因此我们难以接受。”对此，国民力量方面反驳称：“根据民主化运动决定‘损害赔偿对象’，与决定国民应当尊敬的英雄即‘功勋者’，是不同层面的问题”，“但该法案对适用对象的界定模糊，可能过度扩大民主化运动的认定范围，甚至将缺乏国民共识的事件也包含在内。”国民力量有关负责人指出：“在警察人员因催泪弹死亡的同意大事件中，为筹措运动资金而实施暴力行动的南民战（朝鲜民族解放战线）事件相关人士，也可能成为民主功勋者的审查对象。”国民力量通过社交媒体传播梳理《民主功勋者法》问题的卡片新闻等，为阻止该法案在 plenary会议上通过而展开活动。Moreover，如果民主党再次提出针对大法院院长赵熙大的国政调查案，朝野对抗可能进一步加剧。民主党原计划5日将国政调查要求案提交 plenary会议，并于1至2周后处理，但最近决定就国政调查另行征求意见。稿件来源：KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩国联合通讯社，未经许可禁止转载、再分发，禁止用于人工智能学习及使用> 2026年11月8日 https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-allocat.summary_zh: 总统 John Mahama 宣布在2027年预算中追加拨款 GH¢250 million，用于继续推进并完成 Blekusu 第二阶段海岸防护项目。他说：“我也听到了你们提出的诉求，即不间断地继续推进并完成 Blekusu 第二阶段海岸防护项目。”
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-allocat.body: President John Mahama has announced an additional GH¢250 million allocation in the 2027 budget for the continuation and completion of the Blekusu Phase Two Coastal Protection Project. The President said the funding is intended to ensure the uninterrupted execution of the project intended to deal with the severity of coastal erosion in the area. Addressing the 2026 Hogbetsotso Festival, President Mahama said the additional allocation is in response to appeals by traditional leaders and residents for the project to be completed. “I have also heard your appeal for the uninterrupted continuation and completion of the Blekusu Phase Two Coastal Protection Project,” he said. The announcement comes amid concerns about the impact of coastal erosion on communities along Ghana's coastline, particularly homes, fishing livelihoods, schools and other community infrastructure. The Blekusu Phase Two project is expected to protect an eight-kilometre stretch of coastline, covering Blekusu, Agavedzi, Salakope, Amutsinu and Adina in the Ketu South Municipality of the Volta Region. The project was officially launched in July 2025 and is designed to protect the five communities from persistent tidal waves and coastal erosion, which have destroyed homes, displaced residents and threatened livelihoods over the years. It involves the construction of 37 groynes, reinforced embankments and dune restoration works. Additional facilities, including a modern fish market, cold storage and fish processing facilities, are also part of the development plan. The project is being undertaken by Amandi Holdings Limited. Beyond the Blekusu project, President Mahama announced that GH¢685 million has been allocated to commence coastal protection interventions under the West African Coastal Areas Resilience Investment Project (WACA). He said the funding would support a combination of engineering and environmental interventions to address coastal erosion and protect vulnerable communities. The President added that the project would also involve lagoon and watershed rehabilitation, alongside livelihood support for communities within the targeted programme areas, particularly young people, women and persons with disabilities. WACA is a coastal resilience programme designed to address erosion, flooding, pollution and environmental degradation along vulnerable coastal areas. It combines physical infrastructure with environmental restoration and community-level interventions. President Mahama also called on traditional authorities and residents to support efforts to protect mangroves and wetlands, warning that their destruction weakens the shoreline and increases the vulnerability of coastal communities. “It is a known fact that the unrestricted destruction of mangroves and coastal vegetation weakens our shoreline and leaves our coast vulnerable to erosion,” he said. He urged residents to support the protection of the natural environment as part of efforts to safeguard coastal settlements

https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-allocat.body_zh: 约翰·马哈马总统宣布，将在2027年预算中追加GH¢250000000拨款，用于续建并完成布莱库苏海岸防护二期工程。总统表示，这笔资金旨在确保工程不间断推进，以应对该地区海岸侵蚀严重的问题。在2026年霍格贝措索节上，马哈马总统说，追加拨款是为了回应传统领袖和居民要求完成该工程的呼吁。他说：“我也听到了你们要求不间断推进并完成布莱库苏海岸防护二期工程的呼吁。”这一宣布出台之际，人们正担忧海岸侵蚀对加纳沿海社区造成的影响，尤其是住宅、渔业生计、学校及其他社区基础设施。布莱库苏二期工程预计将保护8公里长的海岸线，涵盖沃尔塔地区凯图南市布莱库苏、阿加韦齐、萨拉科佩、阿穆齐努和阿迪纳。该工程于2025年7月正式动工，旨在保护这5个社区免受持续侵袭的潮浪和海岸侵蚀；多年来，这些灾害摧毁了住宅、迫使居民迁移，并威胁到当地生计。工程包括修建37座防波丁坝、加固堤岸和修复沙丘。发展规划还包括建设现代化鱼市、冷藏设施和鱼类加工设施等配套设施。该工程由Amandi Holdings Limited承建。除布莱库苏项目外，马哈马总统宣布，已拨款GH¢685000000，用于启动西非沿海地区韧性投资项目（WACA）下的海岸防护措施。他说，这笔资金将支持工程措施与环境措施相结合，以应对海岸侵蚀并保护脆弱社区。总统补充称，该项目还将包括潟湖和流域修复，并为项目目标区域内的社区提供生计支持，重点关注青年、妇女和残障人士。WACA是一项海岸韧性计划，旨在解决脆弱沿海地区的侵蚀、洪涝、污染和环境退化问题，将实体基础设施建设与环境修复、社区层面的干预措施结合起来。马哈马总统还呼吁传统权力机构和居民支持保护红树林和湿地，并警告称，破坏这些生态区域会削弱海岸线，增大沿海社区的脆弱性。他说：“众所周知，无限制地破坏红树林和沿海植被会削弱我们的海岸线，使我们的海岸更容易遭受侵蚀。”他敦促居民支持保护自然环境，以此作为保障沿海聚落安全努力的一部分

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: A faction of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), led by former Minister of Special Duties and Inter-Governmental Affairs, Kabiru Turaki, has said its legal team is reviewing the Court of Appeal judgement affirming the Wike-backed faction as the party’s authentic leadership. The Court of Appeal, in a unanimous judgement delivered last Wednesday, upheld the earlier decision of the Federal High Court dismissing a suit challenging the leadership of the Wike-backed faction of the PDP, chaired by Abdulrahman Mohammed.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 人民民主党（PDP）的一个派别表示，其法律团队正在研究上诉法院维持由 Wike 支持的派别为该党合法领导机构的判决。前特别事务与政府间事务部长 Kabiru Turaki 领导该派别。上诉法院上周三作出的一致判决维持了联邦高等法院此前的裁决，即驳回针对人民民主党（PDP）由 Abdulrahman Mohammed 担任主席的 Wike 支持派别领导权提出的诉讼。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: A faction of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), led by former Minister of Special Duties and Inter-Governmental Affairs, Kabiru Turaki, has said its legal team is reviewing the Court of Appeal judgement affirming the Wike-backed faction as the party’s authentic leadership. The faction said its lawyers would advise on whether to challenge the judgement at the Supreme Court after reviewing its legal implications. It, however, expressed optimism that it would eventually be recognised as the PDP’s authentic national leadership. Mr Turaki disclosed this on Saturday when a delegation of governorship candidates who had obtained nomination and expression of interest forms from his faction paid a solidarity visit to its leaders in Abuja. The candidates said the visit was aimed at encouraging the faction’s leadership to develop a strategic plan to sensitise and unite party members, particularly at the grassroots level. The candidates were Sunday Biggs (Plateau), Ladi Hassan (Kwara), Joel Danlami (Taraba), Caleb Myebangara (Adamawa), Isah Muqaddam (Gombe), Lawal Umar (Kaduna), Ibrahim Abdullahi (Kebbi), Yakubu Mu’azu (Jigawa) and Zanna Gaddama (Borno). Mr Turaki told the delegation that the faction would meet with its legal team to consider its assessment of the judgement before deciding on the next course of action. “I have listened to you carefully, and I want to inform you, and through you to inform Nigerians, that since our judgement last Wednesday, we’ve instructed our team of lawyers to study, say and advise us accordingly. “And I can confirm to you that immediately after this meeting, we’re going to have a meeting with our legal team and they’re going to tell us the result of their assessment of the judgement of the Court of Appeal,” he said. The Court of Appeal, in a unanimous judgement delivered last Wednesday, upheld the earlier decision of the Federal High Court dismissing a suit challenging the leadership of the Wike-backed faction of the PDP, chaired by Abdulrahman Mohammed. The three-member panel was presided over by Ugochukwu Ogakwu, with Laja Balogun and Ruqayyat—Ayoola, who read the judgment. The suit was instituted by the Board of Trustees (BoT) aligned with the Turaki faction. The board is chaired by Adolphus Wabara, a former Senate president. The appeal, marked CA/ABJ/CV/1221/2026, was filed by Mr Wabara and seven others against the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) and six other respondents. The appellants had asked the court to set aside the Federal High Court judgment and compel INEC to recognise the Interim National Working Committee (NWC) led by Mr Turaki. They argued that the committee emerged from a National Executive Committee meeting convened after the Supreme Court judgment in April. However, the Court of Appeal dismissed the appeal, affirming the position of the lower court in favour of the Wike-backed faction. Mr Turaki told the governorship candidates that the faction would continue its efforts to take control of the party through constitutional and legal means. He expressed optimism that the Supreme Court would rule in its favour, paving the way for its candidates to participate in the 2027 general elections. He also predicted that the PDP would win the elections if the faction eventually secured recognition as the party’s authentic leadership. “I want to assure your excellencies and indeed your other colleagues who are not here, and through you also, to assure other candidates, our other respective candidates, that there is indeed going to be a bright sunny day at the end of the tournament. This struggle will continue. We are hopeful that we will win, and that after winning, PDP candidates shall be on the ballot. “And as soon as we are on the ballot, I want to assure you that Nigerians are waiting for us. We shall be winning the 2027 elections by the special grace of God. So on behalf of PDP, I want to thank you so very much for the continuous support, the solidarity that you’ve been giving to us,” he added. Mr Turaki thanked the candidates for their support and advice, assuring them that the faction would continue to work with them and other party organs in accordance with the party’s constitution. He accused unnamed forces of attempting to undermine the party, insisting that the faction would continue to resist efforts to place the PDP in bondage. “Now, PDP has come to stay, and PDP will continue to fight to free itself from the shackles of bondage that some undemocratic forces and elements are trying to put us in,” he said. He also urged the candidates to encourage their supporters to remain calm and hopeful despite the court’s decision. “I pray that God will grant you a journey back home with mercy, and then try to talk to your people to remain calm. Let them remain calm. Fighting is not for those who are seeing victory in sight. So we should not fight. “We should remain resolute. We should remain prepared, because even if it is a few days to the date of the election, and the shackles, the bondage of our party are freed, we will get to the polls. And by the special grace of God, we will emerge victorious,” he said. Speaking earlier on behalf of the delegation, Mr Biggs, the PDP governorship candidate in Plateau State, said the visit was intended to demonstrate solidarity with the faction’s leadership and encourage it to pursue all available legal options. “The visit was to interact with the INWC to show solidarity with them and to encourage them to undertake a strategic plan aimed at sensitising and unifying the party, especially at the grassroots level. “Furthermore, to ensure that the appeal to the Supreme Court is pursued with urgency, competence and every necessary legal preparation,” he said. Mr Biggs also urged the faction to explore reconciliation and constructive engagement with aggrieved members to resolve the party’s leadership crisis. “We also want them to establish a broader platform for reconciliation and constructive engagement among aggrieved members. The national publicity secretary should ensure that effective communication with party members is regularly held to prevent misinformation, speculation and unnecessary anxiety. “The party should develop a comprehensive political and organisational strategy to strengthen the party ahead of the 2027 general elections,” he said
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 人民民主党派系可能就承认Wike支持的领导层的上诉法院判决提出异议
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh:
人民民主党（PDP）的一个派系表示，其法律团队正在审议上诉法院维持由Wike支持的派系为该党合法领导层的判决。该派系称，在评估判决的法律影响后，其律师将就是否向最高法院提出挑战提供建议。不过，该派系乐观地认为，最终将获承认是该党合法的全国领导机构。图拉基周六透露了上述情况。当时，一批已从其派系取得州长候选人提名和意向书表格的州长候选人代表团前往阿布贾，对该派系领导人进行声援访问。候选人包括Sunday Biggs（普拉州）、Ladi Hassan（夸拉州）、Joel Danlami（塔拉巴州）、Caleb Myebangara（阿达瓦州）、Isah Muqaddam（贡贝州）、Lawal Umar（卡杜纳州）、Ibrahim Abdullahi（凯比州）、Yakubu Mu’azu（吉加瓦州）和Zanna Gaddama（博尔诺州）。图拉基告诉代表团，该派系将与法律团队会面，考虑其对判决的评估结果，再决定下一步行动。

“我已经认真听取了你们的意见。我想告诉你们，并通过你们告知尼日利亚人民，自上周三作出判决以来，我们已指示律师团队进行研究、提出意见并据此向我们提供建议。

“我可以向你们确认，这次会面结束后，我们将立即与法律团队开会，他们将告诉我们对上诉法院判决进行评估的结果。”他说。

上诉法院上周三以一致通过的判决维持了联邦高等法院此前的裁定，即驳回针对PDP由Wike支持的派系领导权提出的诉讼。该派系由Abdulrahman Mohammed担任主席。审判由三人小组进行，Ugochukwu Ogakwu主持，Laja Balogun和Ruqayyat—Ayoola参加，后者宣读了判决。该诉讼由与图拉基派系立场一致的受托人董事会提起。董事会由前参议院议长Adolphus Wabara主持。编号为CA/ABJ/CV/1221/2026的上诉由Wabara先生等8人针对独立国家选举委员会（INEC）及其他6名被上诉人提出。上诉人请求法院撤销联邦高等法院的判决，并强制INEC承认由图拉基先生领导的临时全国工作委员会（NWC）。他们主张，该委员会是在最高法院于4月作出判决后召开的全国执行委员会会议上产生的。然而，上诉法院驳回了上诉，维持了下级法院支持Wike支持派系的立场。

图拉基告诉州长候选人，该派系将继续通过符合党章和法律的手段争取掌控该党。他乐观地认为，最高法院将作出有利于该派系的裁决，为其候选人参加2027年大选铺平道路。他还预言，如果该派系最终获承认是该党的合法领导机构，PDP将赢得此次选举。

“我想向各位阁下，以及确实向今天不在场的其他同事，并通过你们向其他候选人和我们各自的其他候选人保证，赛事终将有阳光灿烂的一天。这场斗争还将继续。我们希望能够获胜，获胜后，PDP候选人将出现在选票上。

“而且，一旦我们出现在选票上，我要向你们保证，尼日利亚人民正在等待我们。凭借上帝的特别恩典，我们将赢得2027年选举。因此，我谨代表PDP向你们致以最诚挚的感谢，感谢你们一直以来的支持和声援。”他补充说。

图拉基感谢候选人的支持和建议，并保证该派系将继续依照党章与他们及该党其他机构合作。他指责一些未具名势力企图破坏该党，并坚持称该派系将继续抵抗使PDP陷入束缚的企图。

“现在，PDP已经站稳脚跟，PDP将继续抗争，摆脱一些不民主势力和因素企图加诸我们身上的奴役枷锁。”他说。

他还敦促候选人鼓励支持者，尽管法院作出了判决，仍应保持冷静和希望。

“我祈祷上帝以恩典护送你们平安回家，然后设法告诉你们的人民保持平静。让他们保持平静。胜利已在望的人不需要战斗。因此，我们不应争斗。

“我们应保持坚定，应做好准备，因为即使距离选举日只有几天，即使我们党所受的枷锁和束缚得以解除，我们仍会走进投票站。凭借上帝的特别恩典，我们将取得胜利。”他说。

此前，代表团发言人、PDP普拉州州长候选人Biggs先生表示，此次访问旨在向该派系领导人表达声援，并鼓励其采取一切可用的法律行动。

“此次访问是为了与NWC交流，向他们表达声援，并鼓励他们制定战略计划，推动全党上下开展宣传和团结工作，尤其是在基层层面。

“此外，还要确保及时、熟练且做好一切必要法律准备地向最高法院提出上诉。”他说。

Biggs先生还敦促该派系探索和解及与心怀不满的成员开展建设性接触，以解决该党的领导层危机。

“我们还希望他们建立一个更广泛的平台，让心怀不满的成员参与和解及建设性接触。全国宣传书记应确保定期与党员进行有效沟通，防止错误信息、臆测和不必要的焦虑。

“该党应制定全面的政治和组织战略，在2027年大选前加强全党建设。”他说。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: Donald Trump’s Republican Party suffered a historic landslide defeat in the US midterm elections on November 3, 2026, as a massive “blue wave” delivered control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate to the Democratic Party. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 2026年11月3日美国中期选举中，特朗普的共和党遭遇历史性惨败。随着强大的“蓝色浪潮”令民主党同时掌控众议院和参议院，特朗普在一定程度上将败选归咎于共和党候选人 themselves。分析人士预计，随着国会中的共和党人开始着眼2028年总统选举周期中自身的政治生存，特朗普对共和党的严密掌控将会松动。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: Alhamdulillah. All praise is due to Allah, the Almighty, the Subduer, the One who elevates whom He wills and deposes whom He wills. We praise Him, we seek His guidance, and we ask for His forgiveness. We bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, alone without partners, and we bear witness that Muhammad (Peace be upon him) is His servant and final Messenger. Dear servants of Allah! I advise you and myself to fear Allah. For indeed, the final outcome belongs only to the mindful. Allah warns us in the Noble Qur’an. He says: “Say, ‘O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honour whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is all good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.'” [Qur’an, 3:26] Dear brothers and sisters! Donald Trump’s Republican Party suffered a historic landslide defeat in the US midterm elections on November 3, 2026, as a massive “blue wave” delivered control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate to the Democratic Party. This sweeping victory effectively turns President Trump into a “lame duck” for the final two years of his presidency, crippling his legislative power and subjecting his administration to intense congressional oversight. The defeat was driven by a combination of key state flips, major candidate upsets, and clear voter dissatisfaction with foreign and economic policies. The scale of the Republican losses stunned political analysts, breaking decades-old voting patterns as Democrats flipped deep-red strongholds. In arguably the most historic race of the night, Democrat James Talarico defeated Republican Ken Paxton to claim a Texas Senate seat. A Democrat had not won a Senate election in Texas since 1988. Democrats broke a nearly three-decade streak by flipping a Senate seat in South Carolina, alongside major Senate victories in traditional Republican strongholds like Iowa and Kansas. Longtime Republican Senator Susan Collins was ousted by Democrat Troy Jackson in Maine, while Democrat Chris Pappas defeated former Republican Senator John Sununu in New Hampshire. In his post-election media appearances, President Donald Trump openly conceded that the ongoing US-Israel war against Iran, which significantly drove up American consumer prices, played a massive role in alienating voters. Exit polling indicated that voters overwhelmingly viewed the election as a direct referendum on Trump’s polarising presidency, citing the economy and the state of democracy as their top motivators for voting blue. Trump partially blamed the losses on the Republican candidates themselves. He distanced himself from several failed campaigns, admitting that voters simply “didn’t like the candidates” he had put forward. Now with Democrats commanding both chambers, they now hold the power to block Trump’s legislative wishlist, pull back funding, and launch extensive congressional investigations into the White House. Analysts expect Trump’s iron-clad grip on his own party to loosen as congressional Republicans begin looking ahead to their political survival in the 2028 presidential election cycle. Here, the core lesson of worldly authority is that power belongs entirely to Allah, and whenever a leader cloaks themselves in pride, their eventual fall serves as a universal sign for those who reflect. For example, look across history and look closely at our world today. We witness the rise and fall of leaders who believed they were untouchable. When we look at political figures who build their entire legacy on the pillars of arrogance, division, mockery, and absolute pride—such as Donald Trump—their sudden, crashing defeats are not merely political news. They are profound, spiritual realities. For years, an arrogant leader may believe that their wealth, their media machinery, their passionate crowds, and their temporary power make them immune to failure. They speak as if they control the destiny of nations. They treat the vulnerable with disdain, disregard justice, and mock the truth. But Allah is Al-Mutakabbir—The Supreme, the Only One Justified in Pride. When a human being attempts to wear the cloak of pride, Allah strips it away to show the creation how fragile man truly is. The transition from the highest seat of worldly power to a sudden, humbling loss is a clear sign. It is a modern manifestation of the ancient truth: No matter how high you rise in the eyes of the world, if your foundation is arrogance, your fall is a decree already written. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) gave us a definition of arrogance that pierces through every political speech and campaign. He said: “Arrogance is rejecting the truth and looking down upon people.” [Sahih Muslim] When leaders reject absolute truths, manipulate realities for personal gain, and view ordinary citizens as mere tools for their ego, they enter a losing battle against the Divine Law. The Qur’an recounts the stories of Pharaoh, Qarun, and Namrud. They did not fall because they lacked wealth or armies; they fell because they forgot they were merely dust walking on dust. Any politician, leader, or person of authority who fails to learn from these downfalls is blind to history. Power is a temporary loan, not a permanent possession. Today you are on the throne; tomorrow you are a cautionary tale. This lesson is not just for the rulers in palaces; it is a mirror for our own hearts. If a man who controlled nuclear codes and global economies can be humbled overnight, who are we to be arrogant in our homes, workplaces, or communities? True strength lies in humility and justice, not in loud boasts or oppressive policies. Do not despair when tyrants or arrogant leaders seem to dominate. Allah gives them respite, but He never forgets. Respected brothers and sisters! Remember that, your voter’s card is not a mere piece of plastic; it is a sacred trust and amanah, a formal testimony and Shahadah, and a powerful instrument of Amru bil-Ma’ruf wan-Nahyu anil-Munkar: enjoining good and forbidding evil. In the light of Islamic jurisprudence and spiritual accountability, how we use—or neglect—this tool (voters card) will be weighed by Allah Almighty on the Day of Judgment. And know that the religion of Islam is not a religion restricted only to the corners of the Mosque, nor is it isolated from the affairs of the society in which we live. Allah Almighty says in the Noble Qur’an: Dear brothers and sisters! Know that, when you hold your voter’s card, you are holding a great pen that writes the future of your Ummah. In the scales of the Shari’ah, casting a vote is a form of Shahadah and Testimony. When you vote for a leader, you are testifying before Allah that this person is capable, trustworthy, and just. If you sell that vote for a fleeting worldly gain, or if you cast it out of blind tribalism or nepotism for an oppressor, you have borne false witness—a major sin in Islam. To withhold your vote when your Ummah needs righteous leaders is to conceal the truth. Allah Almighty warns us: “…And do not conceal testimony, for whoever conceals it – his heart is indeed sinful. And Allah is Knowing of what you do.” [Qur’an, 2:283] Rise, claim your card, guard your amanah, and let your vote be a witness for you, not against you, on the Day we return to Him. Dear brothers and sisters! To truly understand the weight of civic engagement in Islam, we must look at the three dimensions of what a voter’s card represent: The power to choose who governs your resources, protects your rights, and maintains safety is a trust given to you. Abdicating this responsibility allows corruption to thrive unchecked. In Islamic law, a vote acts as a recommendation and Tazkiyah, and a testimony and Shahadah. ● Voting for competence means you testify that the candidate will stand up for the poor, fund schools, and secure communities. ● Selling or wasting a vote means bearing a false witness, making the voter spiritually complicit in every act of injustice that politician commits while in office. If the leader you help elect builds hospitals, establishes justice, and alleviates poverty, a share of the reward belongs to you. Conversely, if that leader plunders the land, oppresses the weak, and brings ruin, the psychological and spiritual burden of that systemic evil attaches to those who brought them to power. It is easy to fall into despair. It is easy to look at the political landscape and say, “My single vote will change nothing. The system is entirely broken.” But remember the story of the ant in the army of Prophet Sulaiman. When the massive army approached, a tiny ant did not remain silent thinking its voice was insignificant. It called out to save its nation: Allah Almighty immortalised that single ant’s effort in the Qur’an. You are not responsible for fixing the entire world by yourself, but you are entirely responsible for the weight of your own hand. When Allah asks you on the Day of Judgment, “When you saw injustice, when you saw the weak suffering, what did you do with the tools (voters card) I gave you?”—your voter’s card will be part of that questioning. Do not let your answer be that you voluntarily chose silence. And finally, dear brothers and sisters! In the 2026 US midterm elections, Muslim candidates achieved historic victories across federal and state levels, including the election of the first-ever Muslim US Senator. They are as follows: Made history as the first Muslim ever elected to the US Senate after defeating Republican Mike Rogers. Won the race for New Jersey’s 12th Congressional District, becoming the first Muslim elected to represent New Jersey in Congress. Won New York’s 13th Congressional District, making history as the first Latina Muslim woman elected to Congress. Successfully secured her fifth term representing Minnesota’s 5th Congressional District. Retained her seat in Michigan’s 12th Congressional District. Won re-election to continue representing Indiana’s 7th Congressional District. Won her congressional race in California’s 12th Congressional District. Elected as the first Muslim state legislators in the Illinois House of Representatives. Made history as the first Muslims elected to the Maine State Legislature. Became the first Muslims elected to serve in the Ohio state legislature. Achieved history as the first Muslims elected to the Texas Legislature. Re-elected/elected to the Georgia State Senate and House, expanding Muslim representation in the state. Secured legislative seats, bringing Minnesota’s total to 5 elected Muslim state lawmakers. Became the first Muslim lawmaker elected to the Oklahoma state legislature. Made history as the first Muslim elected to Delaware’s state legislature. Elected to represent her district in the Colorado state legislature. We ask Allah to purify our hearts from pride, to grant us leaders who fear Him and show mercy to the people, and to make our final actions our best actions. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. May the peace, blessings and salutations of Allah be upon our noble Messenger, Muhammad, and upon his family, his Companions and his true followers. Murtadha Muhammad Gusau is the Chief Imam of Nagazi-Uvete Jumu’ah and the late Alhaji Abdur-Rahman Okene’s Mosques, Okene, Kogi State, Nigeria. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 让特朗普的共和党败选成为任何傲慢政治家的教训！——穆尔塔达·古萨乌撰文
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh:
赞颂真主。万赞全归至高大至强、制服万有、抬高祂意欲抬升者、贬低祂意欲贬低者的真主。我们赞颂祂、寻求祂的指引并求祂赦宥。我们作证：除真主外，绝无应受崇拜的神明，真主是独一无二的；我们作证：穆罕默德（愿主赐他平安）是祂的仆人及最后的使者。真主的众仆啊！我劝勉你们，也劝勉我自己敬畏真主。因为确切的结局只属于敬畏者。真主在尊贵的《古兰经》中警告我们说：‘你说：“真主啊，权柄的主啊！你赐主权给谁，就赐给谁；你收回主权给谁，就从谁那里收回。你荣耀谁，就荣耀谁；你卑微谁，就卑微谁。一切美善都在祂手中。确确实实，祂对于万事是全能的。”’（《古兰经》3:26）

亲爱的弟兄姊妹们！2026年11月3日美国中期选举中，一场巨大的“蓝色浪潮”让民主党掌控了众议院和参议院，唐纳德·特朗普的共和党因此遭受历史性的惨败。这场全面胜利实际上使特朗普总统在任期最后两年成为“跛脚鸭”，削弱了他的立法权，也令其政府受到国会严密监督。此次败选由多个因素共同造成，包括关键州翻转、多名主要候选人意外落败，以及选民对外交和经济政策明显的不满。共和党的惨败规模令政治分析人士震惊，打破了延续数十年的投票模式，民主党翻转了深红州的传统票仓。当晚可以说最具历史意义的竞选中，民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科击败共和党人肯·帕克斯顿，夺得得克萨斯州联邦参议院席位。自1988年以来，民主党人从未赢得得克萨斯州参议院选举。民主党人还在南卡罗来纳州夺取一个参议院席位，终结了近30年的连胜纪录，并在爱荷华州、堪萨斯州等共和党传统票仓取得重大参议院胜利。共和党资深参议员苏珊·柯林斯在缅因州败给民主党人特洛伊·杰克逊，民主党人克里斯·帕帕斯也在新罕布什尔州击败前共和党参议员约翰·苏努努。

选后接受媒体采访时，唐纳德·特朗普总统公开承认，美国与以色列对伊朗的战争大幅推高美国消费者价格，是疏远选民的首要原因之一。出口民调显示，压倒性多数选民把此次选举视为对特朗普两极化总统任期的一次直接公投，并称经济状况和民主现状是他们投票支持民主党的首要动因。特朗普将部分败选归咎于共和党候选人本人。他与数场失败的竞选活动撇清关系，承认选民“不喜欢”他推举的候选人。如今民主党掌控国会两院，掌握了阻止特朗普立法愿望清单、撤回拨款以及针对白宫发起广泛国会调查的权力。分析人士预计，随着国会共和党人开始着眼2028年总统选举周期中自身的政治生存，特朗普对共和党的铁腕控制将会松动。

在这里，尘世权力的核心教训是：权力完全属于真主。领导人一旦披上骄傲的外衣，其最终垮台便成为留给所有善于反思者的普世警示。回顾历史，仔细审视今天的世界，我们看到许多领导人崛起又跌落，他们曾以为自己不可战胜。当我们看到某些政治人物把全部政治遗产建立在傲慢、分裂、嘲讽和绝对自傲的支柱上——例如唐纳德·特朗普——他们突如其来的惨败不仅仅是政治新闻，更是深刻的spiritual现实。多年来，一个傲慢的领导人可能以为，自己的财富、媒体机器、热烈人群和暂时权力能让自己免于失败。他们说话时仿佛掌控着国家的命运，蔑视弱势者，无视正义，嘲弄真理。但真主是Al-Mutakabbir——至高者、唯一配得骄傲者。当人企图披上骄傲的外衣时，真主会将其剥去，让受造界看清人究竟何等脆弱。从尘世权力最高位置骤然跌落并遭受羞辱，是明确的征兆。它以现代方式显现了一个古老的真理：无论你在世人眼中攀得多高，如果根基是傲慢，你的跌落早已写定。

先知穆罕默德（愿主赐他平安）曾对骄傲作出一个定义，足以穿透每一篇政治演说和竞选活动。他说：“傲慢就是拒绝真理并俯视他人。”（《穆斯林圣训实录》）当领导人拒绝绝对真理，为个人利益操纵现实，并把普通公民仅视为满足其自我需要的工具时，他们便在与神圣法则进行一场必败的战争。《古兰经》讲述了法老、卡伦和 Namrud 的故事。他们并非因缺乏财富或军队而垮台；他们之所以跌落，是因为忘了自己不过是行走于尘土的尘土。任何未能从这些覆亡中汲取教训的政治家、领导人或掌权者，都是对历史视而不见。权力是一笔暂时的 loan，而非永久财产。今天你坐在王座上，明天你就会成为警世寓言。这堂课不只是给宫殿里的统治者上的，也是给我们自己内心的一面镜子。如果一个掌控核密码和全球经济的人都能一夜之间受挫，那么我们凭什么在家中、工作场所或社区里傲慢呢？真正的力量在于谦卑和正义，而非喧闹的夸耀或压迫性政策。

当暴君或傲慢领导人看似主宰一切时，不要绝望。真主给予他们延缓之期，但祂从不遗忘。

受尊敬的弟兄姊妹们！请记住，你们的选民卡并不只是一块塑料片；它是一项神圣托付和 amanah，一份正式证词和 Shahadah，也是一种强有力的 Amru bil-Ma’ruf wan-Nahyu anil-Munkar 工具，即劝善戒恶。按照伊斯兰法学和属灵问责，我们如何使用或忽视这一工具（选民卡），全能的真主都将在审判日予以衡量。你们还要知道，伊斯兰教并非只局限于清真寺角落的宗教，也与我们所生活社会的事务隔绝。全能的真主在尊贵的《古兰经》中说：

亲爱的弟兄姊妹们！要知道，当你手中握着选民卡时，你便握着一支书写你们教胞未来的大笔。在 Shari’ah 的天平上，投票既是一种建议，也是 Tazkiyah，同时还是一份证词和 Shahadah。当你投票支持一位领导人时，你是在真主面前作证，声明此人有能力、可信且正直。如果你为短暂的世界利益出卖选票，或出于盲目部落主义、任人唯亲而把选票投给压迫者，你便作了假证——这是伊斯兰教中的重大罪过。当你的教胞需要正直领导人时，你却拒绝投票，那就是隐瞒真理。全能的真主警告我们说：‘……也不可隐瞒证词，因为凡隐瞒证词的人，他的心确有罪过。真主是全知你们行为的。’（《古兰经》2:283）

https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-annou.body: President John Dramani Mahama has unveiled plans to invest more than $9 billion in sectors with high job creation potential between 2027 and 2030 as part of a new policy initiative dubbed the New Economy. The initiative is expected to be detailed in the 2027 national budget, which Finance Minister Cassiel Ato Forson is scheduled to present to Parliament on Thursday, November 12. Speaking at the 2026 Hogbetsotso Festival on Saturday, November 7, President Mahama said the proposed investment would drive economic growth, widen access to employment opportunities and create sustainable livelihoods for Ghanaians. He explained that the next phase of his government's development agenda would prioritise ensuring that citizens could secure decent and dignified means of livelihood. “In this presentation, we will outline our plan for what we call the New Economy. This is a bold initiative that will seek to invest over $9 billion in job-rich sectors of the economy between 2027 and 2030. “The Volta Region is expected to benefit greatly under the New Economy policy, particularly in the areas of textiles, garments, commercial agriculture, hospitality and tourism,” he said. President Mahama noted that these sectors had been selected because of their capacity to boost economic activity and generate employment, particularly in the Volta Region. The President also acknowledged ongoing development projects in various districts, including the construction of health facilities, classroom blocks and feeder roads, financed through the District Assemblies Common Fund. He attributed the increased financial resources available to district assemblies to a directive issued shortly after he assumed office, which requires that at least 80 per cent of the District Assemblies Common Fund be transferred directly to district administrations to facilitate development at the local level

https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/del.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Qutab Road recorded the highest congestion among the 10 identified locations, at 59.10 km a day, followed by Chirag Delhi at 42.57 km and Baratooti Chowk at 38.90 km. Lothiyan Marg–Church Road, with 34.44 km, and Kalindi Kunj, with 30.76 km, completed the top five. The findings point to a problem that extends beyond the sheer volume of vehicles on Delhi’s roads, which is a common concern flagged by traffic officials on ground. At several locations, commercial establishments, wholesale markets, roadside parking, loading and unloading, and encroachments reduce the usable road space. At others, poorly channelled traffic, constrained approaches and conflicting movements at junctions contribute to queues. Qutab Road emerged as a persistent congestion hotspot, ranking among the most congested locations in most months. The problem is attributed to high commercial activity, parking, loading and unloading, encroachments and heavy traffic demand. The suggested interventions include designated loading bays, parking and encroachment management, and a review of signal timings. Chirag Delhi, meanwhile, has witnessed a sharp deterioration. Its daily congestion length increased from around 23.6 km in September 2025 to more than 42 km in September 2026, a rise of nearly 79%. Peak-hour traffic, construction-related disruption and constrained approaches have been identified as the major factors. Signal optimisation, better channelisation and improvements to the junction’s geometry have been recommended. At Baratooti Chowk, wholesale-market activity, freight movement, roadside parking and encroachments contribute to congestion. Although the location recorded an improvement of around 21% over the previous year, it continues to figure among the worst-affected stretches. Timed freight operations and better parking management have been identified as possible solutions. Lothiyan Marg–Church Road recorded 34.44 km of daily congestion, with roadside parking and the movement of buses and heavy commercial vehicles contributing to the problem. At Kalindi Kunj, where congestion stood at 30.76 km a day, the convergence of traffic from multiple directions, bottleneck geometry and peak-hour demand were identified as the main concerns. The remaining locations in the list include IIT Flyover (26.79 km a day), Ajmeri Gate (26.56 km), Bhavbhuti Marg near New Delhi Railway Station (25.57 km), Chatta Rail Junction (24.78 km) and Saraswati Marg–DB Gupta Road (22.53 km). At IIT Flyover, the bottleneck is linked to the flyover’s approach, institutional traffic and peak-hour demand. Ajmeri Gate and Bhavbhuti Marg face a different set of challenges, with pedestrian movement, railway-station access, auto-rickshaws and e-rickshaws, and passenger pick-up and drop-off activity competing for road space. Chatta Rail Junction has been flagged for conflicting traffic movements and inadequate junction design, while commercial activity, mixed traffic, parking and encroachments contribute to congestion along Saraswati Marg–DB Gupta Road. Delhi’s average daily congestion length increased by 12.6% between September 2025 and September 2026, rising from 2,405 km to 2,708 km, according to the monthly assessment. The AI-driven platform, that monitors more than 250 congestion points, including 62 priority hotspots, found that congestion peaked at 3,341 km a day in February 2026, nearly 39% higher than the September 2025 level, before declining over the following months. The platform was earlier implemented by the Bengaluru traffic police for traffic management and congestion mapping. Congestion fell to 2,144 km in March and 2,126 km in April, before reaching a low of 1,562 km a day in June. However, the respite was short-lived, with congestion rising again from July onwards to 2,411 km, followed by 2,736 km in August and 2,708 km in September. The October 2026 assessment subsequently recorded an improvement, with average daily congestion declining by about 8.6% to 2,474.49 km. It recorded a cumulative congestion length of 76,709 km and 161,876 congestion alerts, averaging 5,222 alerts a day, lower than the 5,983 daily alerts recorded in September. Congestion remains relatively low in the early morning, begins rising after 8 a.m. and builds through the day, reaching its peak at around 7 p.m. The hourly congestion length rises to approximately 325 km at the evening peak before falling sharply thereafter. The pattern suggests that Delhi’s traffic pressure is not confined to the morning office commute. Evening commuter movement coincides with commercial activity, deliveries, freight movement, market traffic and other journeys, placing additional pressure on already constrained roads and junctions. Daily congestion levels also fluctuate significantly. In October, the recorded daily congestion length ranged from around 621 km on October 2 to 4,489.75 km on October 31, underlining the extent to which traffic conditions can vary from one day to another. A separate year-on-year comparison of 283 junctions in September 2025 and September 2026 found that 151 had improved. Average weekend congestion per junction declined by nearly 8%, from 1,596 km a day to 1,469 km a day. However, the overall average congestion per junction increased by 2.33%, from around 1,800 km a day to 1,842 km a day, indicating that improvements at individual locations have not necessarily translated into a reduction across the entire network. This comes even as Delhi’s vehicle population increased by 7.93% to 87.61 lakh, according to the Economic Survey of Delhi 2025–26. The analysis points to the need to distinguish between infrastructure and design deficiencies, operational shortcomings and enforcement gaps. The absence of designated loading areas, parking facilities, pedestrian crossings and passenger pick-up and drop-off spaces cannot be addressed through enforcement alone. Similarly, poorly timed signals, inadequate diversions and weak junction management require operational changes. It recommends a combination of optimised and adaptive traffic signals, coordinated junction management, designated loading and unloading spaces, improved pedestrian facilities, organised auto-rickshaw and e-rickshaw stopping areas, parking regulation and targeted restrictions on freight and heavy vehicles. 已成为持续性的拥堵热点，在多数月份的排名中都位居最拥堵地点之列。该问题被归因于高度活跃的商业活动、停车、装卸作业、违规占用道路以及巨大的交通需求。建议采取的干预措施包括设置指定装卸区、加强停车和违规占用管理，以及审查信号灯配时。与此同时，Chirag Delhi 的拥堵状况明显恶化。其每日拥堵长度从 2025 年 9 月的约 23.6 公里增加到 2026 年 9 月的 42 公里以上，增幅接近 79%。高峰时段车流、施工造成的干扰以及引道受限被认定为主要因素。建议优化信号灯、改善交通分流，并调整路口几何布局。Baratooti Chowk 的拥堵则与批发市场活动、货运、路边停车和违规占用道路有关。尽管该地点较上一年的拥堵状况改善了约 21%，但仍属于受拥堵影响最严重的路段之一。分时段组织货运以及加强停车管理已被确定为可能的解决方案。Lothiyan Marg–Church Road 每天拥堵 34.44 公里，路边停车以及公交车和重型商用车辆通行是造成拥堵的重要因素。在 Kalindi Kunj，每天拥堵长度为 30.76 公里，来自多个方向的交通流汇聚、瓶颈路段布局和高峰时段需求被认定为主要问题。榜单中的其他地点包括 IIT Flyover（每天 26.79 公里）、Ajmeri Gate（26.56 公里）、新德里火车站附近的 Bhavbhuti Marg（25.57 公里）、Chatta Rail Junction（24.78 公里）以及 Saraswati Marg–DB Gupta Road（22.53 公里）。IIT Flyover 的瓶颈与高架桥引道、机构车流和高峰时段需求有关。Ajmeri Gate 和 Bhavbhuti Marg 面临另一组挑战，行人通行、火车站接驳、自动三轮车和电动三轮车，以及乘客上下车活动相互争夺道路空间。Chatta Rail Junction 被指出存在交通流冲突和路口设计不足的问题，而 Saraswati Marg–DB Gupta Road 沿线的商业活动、混合交通、停车和违规占用道路加剧了拥堵。根据月度评估，2025 年 9 月至 2026 年 9 月，德里平均每日拥堵长度增加了 12.6%，从 2,405 公里升至 2,708 公里。这个由人工智能驱动、监测 250 多个拥堵点（其中包括 62 个重点热点）的平台发现，2026 年 2 月每日拥堵长度达到 3,341 公里的峰值，比 2025 年 9 月的水平高出近 39%，随后数月逐步下降。该平台此前由班加罗尔警察部门用于交通管理和拥堵制图。3 月拥堵长度降至 2,144 公里，4 月降至 2,126 公里，6 月进一步降至每天 1,562 公里的最低值。然而，这一缓解局面十分短暂，从 7 月起拥堵再次上升，达到 2,411 公里，8 月为 2,736 公里，9 月为 2,708 公里。2026 年 10 月的评估随后记录到改善情况，平均每日拥堵长度下降约 8.6%，至 2,474.49 公里。评估记录了 76,709 公里的累计拥堵长度和 161,876 条拥堵警报，平均每天 5,222 条，低于 9 月记录的每天 5,983 条。凌晨时段的拥堵仍相对较低，上午 8 点后开始上升，并 throughout 全天持续加剧，晚上 7 点左右达到峰值。每小时拥堵长度在晚高峰时升至约 325 公里，此后便迅速下降。这一模式表明，德里的交通压力并非仅限于早高峰上班通勤。晚间通勤车流与商业活动、配送、货运、市场交通及其他出行活动相重合，给本已受限的道路和路口带来额外压力。每日拥堵水平也会出现显著波动。10 月记录的每日拥堵长度从 10 月 2 日的约 621 公里到 10 月 31 日的 4,489.75 公里不等，凸显交通状况在不同日期之间可能发生巨大变化。对 2025 年 9 月和 2026 年 9 月的 283 个路口进行另一项同比比较后发现，其中 151 个路口的拥堵状况有所改善。每个路口的平均周末拥堵长度下降近 8%，从每天 1,596 公里降至每天 1,469 公里。然而，每个路口的平均总体拥堵长度增加了 2.33%，从每天约 1,800 公里升至每天 1,842 公里，表明个别地点的改善未必意味着整个路网的拥堵都会减少。与此同时，根据《德里经济调查 2025–26》，德里机动车保有量增加了 7.93%，达到 8,761 万辆。分析指出，有必要区分基础设施和设计缺陷、运营短板以及执法缺口。缺少指定装卸区、停车设施、人行横道和乘客上下车空间，无法仅靠执法解决。同样，信号灯配时不当、绕行设施不足和路口管理薄弱也需要采取运营措施。报告建议结合使用经过优化且能适应交通变化的信号灯，协调管理路口，设置指定的装卸空间，改善行人设施，规范自动三轮车和电动三轮车的停靠区域，实施停车管理，并对货运车辆和重型车辆实行有针对性的限制。评论必须使用英文，并以完整句子表达。评论不得包含辱骂性或针对个人的内容。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The https://www.myjoyonline.com/seven-compan.body: President John Mahama has announced that seven companies have been shortlisted for the development of the Keta Port in the Volta Region. The companies were selected from 47 that submitted expressions of interest to partner with the Ghana Ports and Harbours Authority (GPHA) as strategic partners for the project. Addressing the 2026 Hogbetsotso Festival, President Mahama said the shortlisted companies have successfully completed the due diligence stage and will now proceed to the next phase of the process. He explained that the next stage would involve completing the designs and securing financing to pave the way for construction to begin. “Due diligence has been conducted, and the list has been shortlisted to seven companies. These seven companies are proceeding to the next stage, which involves completing the designs and arranging the financing for the project to commence,” he said. The President also disclosed that the administration block for the port, which was started under the previous administration, is expected to be completed by the end of the first quarter of 2027. “Government remains committed to advancing the project on a credible foundation,” he assured. On other development projects in the Volta Region, President Mahama announced that the Sogakope-Agodome-Keta Water Project, which stalled following Ghana's debt restructuring, is expected to resume. He said the government signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the contractors in October to facilitate their return to site and the completion of the first phase. On road infrastructure, President Mahama said the Ho-Denu Road is progressing steadily and is expected to be completed in 2027. He added that procurement processes are underway for the reconstruction of the road from Central University at Miotso, near Dawhenya, to Aflao. The government is also working to secure a contractor for the Dabala-Savietula-Keta-Denu Highway. President Mahama further disclosed that several roads in the Anlo area, including the Abor-Atiavi road, has been captured under the World Bank Feeder Roads Project, with procurement expected to begin soon. On healthcare, he said discussions have been initiated during his recent visit to Korea for the resumption of financing for the upgrade of the Volta Regional Hospital in Ho. He said the upgrade would ensure that the facility is befitting of a teaching hospital. The President also announced progress towards establishing a School of Pharmacy under the University of Health and Allied Sciences (UHAS), saying land had been secured and inspected by the committee overseeing its establishment. He said the next steps would involve designing the campus and proceeding to procurement. President Mahama also pledged to support other educational infrastructure requests in the region, including a new dormitory block for Anlo-Afiadenyigba Senior High School, proposed E-Blocks for Shime and Anlo Senior High Schools, and infrastructure improvements at Atiavi Senior High School and Technical School. He further acknowledged calls for the upgrading of Ohawu Agricultural College into a university. On housing, the President said an additional GH¢500 million has been allocated for district housing projects and assured the people of Anlo that the area would benefit. He also said the Anloga 24-hour market project is on track, while preparations for the proposed Aflao Ashigame market have advanced, with land secured and designs completed. According to him, a technical team from China, financed through a grant from the Chinese Government, is expected to visit the project sites to confirm the designs before the release of a US$30 million grant to commence the project. President Mahama urged the Volta Regional Coordinating Council to closely monitor the implementation of the various projects to ensure their timely delivery
https://www.myjoyonline.com/seven-compan.title_zh: 7家公司入围凯塔港开发项目候选名单
https://www.myjoyonline.com/seven-compan.body_zh: 约翰·马哈马总统宣布，已有7家公司入围沃尔塔地区凯塔港的开发名单。这些公司是从提交意向书、拟与加纳港务局（GPHA）合作担任该项目战略伙伴的47家公司中选出的。马哈马总统在2026年霍格贝措索节上表示，入围公司已顺利完成尽职调查阶段，接下来将进入流程的下一阶段。他解释说，下一阶段将包括完成设计并落实融资，为项目开工铺路。他说：“尽职调查已经完成，入围名单共有7家公司。这7家公司正进入下一阶段，包括完成设计并安排项目融资，以便项目启动。”总统还透露，港口行政楼项目在前政府任内已经动工，预计将于2027年第一季度末完工。他保证：“政府仍致力于在可靠的基础上推进项目。”谈及沃尔塔地区的其他发展项目，马哈马总统宣布，在加纳完成债务重组后陷入停滞的索加科佩—阿戈多梅—凯塔供水项目预计将恢复。他表示，政府已于10月与承包商签署谅解备忘录，以便利他们重返工地并完成第一阶段。在道路基础设施方面，马哈马总统说霍—德努公路正稳步推进，预计将于2027年完工。他补充说，从达文亚附近的米奥措中央大学至阿弗劳的道路重建正在开展采购程序。政府还在努力为达巴拉—萨维图拉—凯塔—德努公路确定承包商。马哈马总统进一步透露，安洛地区的多条道路，包括阿博尔—阿蒂亚维公路，已纳入世界银行支线道路项目，采购工作预计很快启动。在医疗方面，他表示，近期访问韩国期间，双方已启动恢复为霍市沃尔塔地区医院升级提供融资的讨论。他说，升级改造将确保该医院达到教学医院的应有标准。总统还宣布，卫生与 Allied Sciences 大学（UHAS）设立药学院的筹备工作取得进展，土地已落实，负责筹建工作的委员会也已完成考察。他说，下一步将包括校区设计和启动采购。马哈马总统还承诺支持该地区的其他教育基础设施需求，包括为安洛—阿菲亚德尼格巴高级中学新建宿舍楼，为希梅和安洛高级中学规划E栋教学楼，以及改善阿蒂亚维高级中学和技术学校的设施。他还回应了将奥豪沃农业学院升级为大学的呼声。在住房方面，总统表示，政府已为地区住房项目追加拨款GH¢500 million，并保证安洛民众将从中受益。他说，安洛加24小时营业市场项目正按计划推进，拟建的阿弗劳阿希加梅市场也已完成前期准备，土地已经落实，设计已经完成。据他介绍，由中国政府赠款资助的中国技术团队预计将前往项目现场核实设计，随后将拨付US$30 million赠款以启动项目。马哈马总统敦促沃尔塔地区协调委员会密切监督各项项目的实施，以确保项目如期交付

https://www.myjoyonline.com/naa-seidu-tu.body: Naa Seidu Tungbani Salinbille II has been outdoored as the new chief of Dorimon in the Wa West District of the Upper West Region. He was first enskinned on June 3, 2022, but was not outdoored following a protracted dispute, which was later settled in his favour by the Upper West Regional House of Chiefs and the National House of Chiefs. The Imams, who served as his spiritual godfathers, accompanied him as he walked around the cow while reciting verses from the Holy Quran before he leaped over it. The ceremony was followed by a durbar attended by delegations from Dagbon, Mamprugu, Burkina Faso and Côte d’Ivoire. In his acceptance speech, Naa Seidu Tungbani Salinbille II thanked the people of Dorimon for the honour and appealed to the government to address the numerous challenges facing the area. He said children and generations yet unborn wanted a community united around a common vision. The Member of Parliament for Wa West, retired Superintendent Peter Lanchene Toobu, spoke about roads, culture and peace. He said the roads linking Wa to Dorimon, Dorimon to Wechiau, and Wechiau to Ga had received the attention of the President. Mr Toobu said that during the President's visit to Wa West, he instructed the Minister for Roads and Highways to ensure that the road was constructed. "Three days ago, I met the Minister for Roads and Highways in Parliament and I asked him what is happening to our road and he said go and tell your chiefs that His Excellency has instructed me to make sure that road is done and I'm making sure that that road is constructed," he said. He said development was coming and that all that was needed was cooperation and collaboration. A message from the Speaker of Parliament was read by his Principal Marshal, Wing Commander Frederick Bawa. The Speaker urged the new chief to create space for dissent and embrace all those whose perspectives might differ from his. A 60-member delegation from Dagbon, led by the Dalunlanaa, Tafah Mahamudu III, attended the ceremony on behalf of the Kampakuya-Naa, Yakubu Abukari II. The Dalunlanaa said the people of Dagbon stood side by side with Naa Seidu Tungbani Salinbille II. A statement from the Mamprugu Kingdom said the new chief was one of their own, sharing a common lineage, tradition, culture and destiny. It said his forefathers migrated from Mamprugu, settled for some time in Dagbon and eventually moved to Dorimon. Delegations from Gbonaa and Goua in Burkina Faso and Côte d’Ivoire also attended the ceremony. The leader of the delegation from Burkina Faso, Chief Canton de Gaoua, Albert Bifaate II, urged the Presidents of Ghana and Burkina Faso to construct a bridge over the Black Volta. He said the bridge would ensure the easy movement of goods and services and boost trade and commerce between the two countries

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/b.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription An ancient mound in Bihar's East Champaran district has been declared an archaeological site of national importance through a central government notification. The site – Ranivas Mound, at Kesariya – is spread over 1.63 acres and is under the ownership of the Bihar government, reads the gazette notification dated November 4 that was issued by the Ministry of Culture. Copies of the said notification were made available to the public on June 8, 2026 and "no objection has been received" from any person with regard to the declaration by the central government, said the notification signed by Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) Director General Yadubir Singh Rawat. A copy of the notification was affixed at a conspicuous place as required under sub-section (1) of section 4 of the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (AMASR) Act, 1958. A total of 3,686 sites around the country are under the care of the ASI, the Centre had informed Parliament in February 2026. A recommendation for listing the ancient Ranivas mound in Bihar as a centrally protected monument was sent to ASI headquarters in Delhi in 2021, a senior official told PTI in September 2022. According to the existing procedure, proposals or recommendations sent by regional ASI circles are examined by a team at the organisation’s headquarters before a final decision is taken on naming them monuments or sites of national importance. In case of meritorious proposals and recommendations, a provisional notification is first made, followed by the issuance of a final gazetted notification. A senior official said the inclusion of new sites under the ambit of the ASI is an ongoing process, based on recommendations received from various ASI “circles”, or regions, across the country from time to time. Centrally protected sites in Bihar fall under the jurisdiction of the ASI’s Patna Circle. Currently, 70 sites in Bihar are under the ambit of the ASI and governed by the Patna Circle, which is one of the oldest regional circles in India. The Patna Circle was earlier known as the Mid-Eastern Circle, and still earlier as the Buddhist Circle, ostensibly because of the important Buddhist monuments lying in the area, according to the Circle’s website. The ruins of the ancient Nalanda University in Bihar, also under the ASI, are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The ancestral house of India’s first president Rajendra Prasad in Ziradei, Siwan, north Bihar, was officially declared a protected monument on May 27, 1991. Its provisional notification was done on October 30, 1990. The Shiva Temple in Gaya was notified by the ASI in 1996. Since then, no fresh site in Bihar had been brought under the ambit of the ASI, the senior official had said in September 2022. The Patna Circle earlier covered Jharkhand and a large number of sites in eastern Uttar Pradesh. While the Ranchi Circle was created in 2003 after Jharkhand was carved out of Bihar in 2000, a separate Sarnath Circle was created in 2013 for sites falling in eastern Uttar Pradesh. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/b.title_zh: 比哈尔邦拉尼瓦斯土丘被宣布为具有国家重要性的纪念碑
https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/b.body_zh: 订阅账户还可享受 Premium Stories、Editorials、Opinions 等内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。印度比哈尔邦东昌帕兰县的一座古土丘，经中央政府发布通知，已被宣布为国家重要考古遗址。文化和旅游部于11月4日发布的官方公报通知称，该遗址位于克萨里亚的拉尼瓦斯土丘，占地1.63英亩，归比哈尔邦政府所有。通知副本于2026年6月8日向社会公开，并由印度考古局（ASI）总监察长亚杜比尔·辛格·拉瓦特签署。通知称，中央政府作出这一宣布后，“未收到任何人的异议”。根据《1958年古迹与考古遗址及遗迹法》（AMASR Act, 1958）第4条第（1）款的规定，通知副本已张贴在显著位置。2026年2月，中央政府告知议会，全国共有3,686处遗址由印度考古局负责管理。2022年9月，一名高级官员告诉印度报业托拉斯（PTI），将比哈尔邦古老的拉尼瓦斯土丘列为中央保护古迹的建议，于2021年送交位于德里的印度考古局总部。按照现行程序，各地区印度考古局分局提交的提案或建议，均由该机构总部的团队审查，之后再就是否将其命名为国家重要古迹或遗址作出最终决定。对于有价值的提案和建议，首先会发布临时通知，随后发布正式的官方公报通知。一名高级官员称，将新遗址纳入印度考古局管理范围是一项持续进行的工作，依据的是该局各分局或地区不时提交的建议。印度考古局在比哈尔邦管理的中央保护遗址，隶属该局巴特那分局管辖。目前，比哈尔邦有70处遗址纳入印度考古局的管理范围，由巴特那分局负责监管；该分局是印度历史最悠久的地区分局之一。据该分局网站称，巴特那分局此前称为中东部分局，更早时称为佛教分局，表面上是因为该地区分布着重要的佛教古迹。同样由印度考古局管理的比哈尔邦古老那烂陀大学遗址，是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。印度首任总统拉金德拉·普拉萨德位于比哈尔邦北部锡万县齐拉代伊的祖居，于1991年5月27日正式宣布为受保护古迹，其临时通知于1990年10月30日发布。加亚的湿婆神庙于1996年被印度考古局列入通知名录。这名高级官员曾在2022年9月表示，自那以后，比哈尔邦没有新增遗址纳入印度考古局的管理范围。巴特那分局此前还负责贾坎德邦以及北方邦东部的大量遗址。2000年贾坎德邦从比哈尔邦分出后，兰契分局于2003年成立；2013年，又为北方邦东部境内的遗址成立了萨纳特分局。印度考古局成立于1861年，亚历山大·坎宁安担任该机构首任负责人。评论必须使用英文，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论指南。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们的文章互动。如果你还没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的账户后，可以查看此前在 Vuukle 上发表的旧评论。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/npp-usa-elec.body: A member of the New Patriotic Party (NPP)’s United States branch, Opoku Boateng, has called for in-person voting and an immediate election timetable as the November 30 deadline for outstanding party polls approaches. In a statement, he raised concerns about what he described as inadequate communication from the committee overseeing the NPP-USA elections. According to Mr Boateng, members have yet to receive an election date, a published timetable or information on the register of eligible voters. “Members are not asking for miracles. They are asking for a timetable,” he said. He cited an October 29, 2026, directive by NPP General Secretary Justin Kodua requiring all outstanding elections to be completed by November 30. Mr Boateng argued that the lack of a clear roadmap was making it difficult for members to prepare and for candidates to organise their campaigns. The statement said the NPP-USA election was initially expected in July 2026 but was postponed after disagreements over an electronic voting system developed by NPP Ghana. According to Mr Boateng, members questioned the platform’s independence and raised concerns that it had not been tested in Ghana's elections. “It is important to understand that rejecting a particular voting platform does not mean rejecting democracy, technology, or the desire to elect leaders,” he said. As an alternative, he proposed voting at the various chapters, with results subsequently collated at the NPP-USA branch level. He also called for consideration of a regulated proxy voting arrangement for members unable to attend physically. He said this should include verification and accountability measures to prevent duplication, impersonation, and abuse. “The proposal is not intended to complicate the election. It is intended to build confidence,” he said. Mr Boateng also questioned how the electoral committee had been constituted. He alleged that the General Secretary established it directly, without the expected consultation with NPP-USA executives. He urged the committee to engage chapter leaders, executives, candidates and members to address concerns and build confidence in the process. His demands include publishing the voter register, allowing members to verify their eligibility and clarifying voting and results-collation procedures. He cautioned against waiting until the final days before the deadline to announce arrangements. “A credible election cannot be organised through last-minute announcements, hurried arrangements, and inadequate communication,” he said. While acknowledging the importance of meeting the deadline, Mr Boateng said speed should not come at the expense of fairness. He appealed to members to remain united despite differences over candidates and voting methods, saying the priority should be an election that strengthens the branch

https://dailytrust.com/2027-election-wil.body: President Bola Tinubu has called on Nigerian youths to actively participate in the 2027 general elections. Speaking during the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential rally in Rivers on Saturday, the President said the outcome of the 2027 elections would have significant implications for the future of young Nigerians. Addressing the youths at the rally, the President said they had a responsibility to shape the country’s future through active participation in the electoral process. “To the youth of Nigeria, I’m looking at you. This election is about you. It’s not about me. Your future depends on this election,” he said. He urged those who had registered as voters but were yet to collect their Permanent Voter Cards (PVCs) to visit the appropriate collection centres, describing the voter card as an important instrument for determining the country’s leadership. The President appealed to young Nigerians not to disregard the opportunity to participate in the electoral process, saying their votes would give them a voice in deciding the direction of the country. “It is left for you to use the weapon you have. And that weapon is the PVC. If you have not collected yours, please go ahead and collect it. Please. I beg you. I take God beg you,” Tinubu said. The President also highlighted his administration’s economic policies, arguing that economic development and the distribution of prosperity were essential to improving the living conditions of Nigerians, particularly young people. He maintained that his government was addressing outstanding financial obligations inherited from previous administrations, including unpaid pensions and gratuities owed to retirees. According to him, billions and trillions of naira in pension and gratuity liabilities had accumulated before his administration assumed office, but efforts were being made to settle the outstanding payments. “The people that governed before, they left unpaid pensions and gratuity in billions and trillions of naira. That is being cleared. So that every family is included. We are sharing prosperity already,” he said. Tinubu said the ongoing efforts to settle the liabilities were part of his administration’s broader commitment to ensuring that more Nigerian families benefited from economic opportunities and government policies. https://www.myjoyonline.com/uk-cannot-ch.summary_zh: 首相表示，自英国近六年前退出欧盟以来，重新加入该集团内部市场是他可以推进的关系重塑选项之一。他说，英国无法从一份可以任意挑选的“单点市场菜单”中选择希望采用的组成部分。但他强调，任何重新加入单一市场的举措——该市场允许商品自由流通且不设边境管制——都将要求英国遵守与其他成员相同的条件。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/uk-cannot-ch.body: The prime minister has said rejoining the bloc's internal market was among options he could pursue as part of a reshaping of ties since the UK's exit from the EU nearly six years ago. But Michel Barnier told the BBC's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg that EU members would insist on the UK readopting certain conditions, such as the free movement of people, to gain access. He said there was not a "single market à la carte" menu from which the UK could pick and choose what elements it wanted to adopt. Barnier - who led the EU delegation during Brexit talks between 2016 and 2021, and had a three-month spell as French prime minister in 2024 - said the "door is open" within Europe to the UK rejoining as an EU member. But he insisted that any move to rejoin the single market - which allows for goods to be freely traded without border controls - would require the UK to follow the same terms as other members. He added that this included compliance with regulations designed to promote the circulation of goods, services, capital and people, referred to collectively within EU institutions as the "four freedoms". "There will be no possibility to have one freedom and not the other. The four freedoms are clearly the four conditions to be inside a single market." Since becoming prime minister in July, Burnham has suggested he could commit Labour to pursuing a much closer future relationship with Europe, including asking to rejoin the organisation as a full member, though he has ruled out major changes before the next election. His predecessors have struck a series of deals with the EU on different aspects of how the UK and EU interact post-Brexit. Both sides are hoping to use a meeting in Brussels in 10 days' time to unveil deals on food standards, youth visas and re-linking British industry to the EU's carbon trading regime. Of the four freedoms, the free movement of people - which allows EU citizens to live and work elsewhere in the bloc without a visa - was a key issue during the 2016 Brexit referendum. Burnham's immediate predecessor, Sir Keir Starmer, ruled out re-establishing it for the UK in Labour's 2024 election manifesto and any move to advocate it again would prove a key dividing line with the Conservatives and Reform UK at a future poll. Burnham recently said in an interview that he would not re-establish free movement of people without a referendum, prompting Downing Street to clarify that he was not advocating its return at this point. He has previously said he wanted to lay out "different options" for the relationship with Europe at the Brussels summit later this month, before trying to find a consensus with the British public on a new relationship. Barnier also predicted that EU countries would reject reinstating the British financial rebate, first negotiated in 1985, that lowered UK contributions towards the EU's annual budget while it was a member. The UK's decision to leave the bloc had created "a new situation", he said, meaning a new rebate would be "off the table". Barnier also compared Reform leader Nigel Farage to French politician Marine Le Pen. He said: "We have our own Farage. It is Mrs Le Pen. The same populism, the same lies, the same false promises." Asked by Kuenssberg to clarify what he was referring to with his accusation of lies, Barnier said "for instance, when Mr Farage and Mr Johnson promised the UK people to get back [£350] million per week, it was not true, it was not possible. It was a lie". The Vote Leave campaign, of which Boris Johnson became a key figure, has been criticised previously for the slogan on the side of their campaign bus that said Britain sent £350m a week to the EU, adding: "Let's fund our NHS instead". Johnson said in 2017 that "once we have settled our accounts, we will take back control of roughly £350m per week. It would be a fine thing as many of us have pointed out if a lot of that money went on the NHS". Critics have said that the £350m per week was an approximate sum which represents a "gross contribution" and did not take into account the UK's £75m-a-week rebate nor the EU's investments in the UK. Johnson has since defended the claim, saying the £350m was based on the UK's gross contribution to the EU, and was in fact an underestimate as UK contributions were due to rise. In his memoirs published in 2024, Johnson said EU money spent in the UK was not "democratically controlled by the British people", and "even if the net figure was only £175m, that was still a hell of a lot of money". Farage, who led Leave UK and was not part of the Vote Leave campaign so not connected to the £350m claim, said: "It is the same old Barnier - arrogant, out of touch and a bully. He vindicates our decision to leave every time he opens his mouth."
https://www.myjoyonline.com/uk-cannot-ch.title_zh: 巴尼耶告诉BBC，英国不能对欧盟单一市场协议“挑三拣四”
https://www.myjoyonline.com/uk-cannot-ch.body_zh: 首相表示，自英国退出欧盟近六年来重塑双方关系之际，重新加入该集团内部市场是他可以采取的选项之一。不过，米歇尔·巴尔尼埃在接受BBC《周日与劳拉·库恩斯伯格对话》节目采访时表示，欧盟成员国会坚持要求英国重新接受某些条件，例如人员自由流动，才能获得准入。他说，并不存在可供英国自行挑选希望采用的要素的“可选单一市场菜单”。巴尔尼埃曾于2016年至2021年英国脱欧谈判期间率领欧盟代表团，并于2024年担任过法国总理三个月。他说，欧洲对英国作为欧盟成员国重新加入的大门仍然敞开。但他强调，任何重新加入单一市场的行动——单一市场允许货物自由贸易且无需边境管控——都将要求英国遵守与其他成员国相同的条款。他补充说，其中包括遵守旨在促进货物、服务、资本和人员流通的法规，欧盟机构将这些法规统称为“四大自由”。“不可能只享有一项自由而不享有其他自由。四大自由显然正是进入单一市场的四项条件。”伯纳姆自7月出任首相以来，曾暗示他可能承诺工党推动与欧洲建立更紧密的未来关系，包括申请以完整成员身份重新加入该组织，但他排除了在下一次选举前进行重大调整的可能。他的前任们已就脱欧后英国与欧盟互动关系的不同方面与欧盟达成一系列协议。双方希望利用10天后在布鲁塞尔举行的会晤，公布有关食品标准、青年签证以及让英国工业重新纳入欧盟碳交易体系的协议。在四大自由中，允许欧盟公民无需签证便可居住在集团内其他地区并工作的“人员自由流动”，是2016年英国脱欧公投期间的一个关键议题。伯纳姆的直接前任、基尔·斯塔默爵士在工党2024年竞选纲领中排除了为英国重新建立人员自由流动，今后任何再次主张此举的行动，都将成为未来选举中工党与保守党和 Reform UK 之间的重要分界线。伯纳姆最近在一次采访中表示，未经全民公投，他不会重新建立人员自由流动，这促使唐宁街澄清称，他目前并未主张恢复人员自由流动。他此前曾说，希望在本月晚些时候举行的布鲁塞尔峰会上阐述与欧洲关系的“不同选项”，随后再努力与英国公众就新的关系达成共识。巴尔尼埃还预测，欧盟国家会拒绝恢复英国财务返利。该返利最初于1985年谈判达成，在英国作为成员国期间降低了英国对欧盟年度预算的缴款额。他说，英国决定离开该集团造成了“新局面”，这意味着新的返利将“不予考虑”。巴尔尼埃还把 Reform 党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇与法国政治人物玛琳·勒庞作比较。他说：“我们也有自己的法拉奇。她就是勒庞夫人。一样的民粹主义，一样的谎言，一样的虚假承诺。”当库恩斯伯格要求巴尔尼埃澄清其指控中的谎言具体所指时，他说：“例如，法拉奇先生和约翰逊先生曾向英国人民承诺，每周能拿回[£350]百万，但这不是真的，也不可能。这是谎言。”曾为鲍里斯·约翰逊赢得关键地位的“英国脱欧公投”运动此前因其宣传巴士侧面的标语而受到批评，该标语称英国每周向欧盟发送£350m，并附言：“不如把这笔钱用于我们的NHS。”约翰逊在2017年表示：“一旦我们结清账目，每周就会收回大约£350m的控制权。正如我们许多人所指出的，如果这些钱中有很大一部分用于NHS，那将是一件很好的事。”批评者表示，每周五£350m是一个约数，代表“总缴款额”，并未计入英国每周£7500万的返利，也未考虑欧盟对英国的投资。约翰逊此后为这一说法辩护，称每周£350m是基于英国对欧盟的总缴款额，而且实际上还是低估，因为英国的缴款额原本将会上升。约翰逊在2024年出版的回忆录中称，欧盟在英国花费的资金并不“由英国人民民主控制”，并表示“即使净额只有£175m，那仍然是一大笔钱”。领导“英国脱欧”运动、但未参与“英国脱欧公投”运动、因而与£350m说法无关的法拉奇说：“还是那个老样子的巴尔尼埃——傲慢、脱离现实，还是个霸凌者。他每次一开口都为我们的脱欧决定提供了佐证。”

Unlock these with Subscription Amid the Opposition’s intensifying protests over alleged electoral malpractice, All India Congress Committee (AICC) general secretary K.C. Venugopal has said that Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar would soon be forced to step down. Inaugurating the ‘Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao’ (Save the Vote, Save the Nation) rally organised by the Kozhikode District Congress Committee at Kozhikode beach on Saturday (November 7, 2026), Mr. Venugopal accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah of using the Election Commission of India to undermine the Congress and manipulate electoral outcomes. Referring to the Haryana Assembly election, in which the Congress lost by a margin of 0.4 percentage points despite predictions of a party wave, he said a booth-level investigation led by Rahul Gandhi had exposed large-scale vote theft. Similar manipulation had allegedly taken place in Maharashtra and Karnataka, he claimed. Mr. Venugopal levelled serious allegations against Mr. Kumar, accusing him of corruption during his earlier stints as Ernakulam District Collector and Public Works department Secretary in Kerala. He also alleged that Mr. Kumar had been entrusted with overseeing the bifurcation of Jammu and Kashmir by Mr. Shah. Criticising the 2023 amendment to the law governing the appointment of election commissioners, he alleged that the Modi government had granted them legal immunity even greater than that enjoyed by the President, Prime Minister, and Chief Justice of India. He also accused the government of removing the Chief Justice of India from the selection committee and replacing him with a Union Minister, despite a Supreme Court judgment providing for the CJI's inclusion. Claiming that 13.32 crore voters had been deleted from electoral rolls across the country, Mr. Venugopal said the exercise threatened not only citizens’ voting rights but also their access to government benefits and entitlements, as voter ID cards were increasingly being linked to welfare provisions. He said the protests in Delhi had unsettled the Prime Minister and the CEC, and warned that any attempt to suppress the agitation using the police or armed forces would invite a strong response from the Opposition. The movement was not merely about electoral victories or making Mr. Gandhi Prime Minister in 2029, but a fight to safeguard every Indian citizen's right to vote and democratic freedoms, he added. Addressing the protesters, AIDSO district secretary Shashikala Meti alleged that the Congress government, which had promised to protect government schools, was pursuing policies such as the Karnataka Public Schools (KPS)-Magnet initiative and an agreement with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) that would undermine the public education system. She termed the move a betrayal of the people. Ms. Meti also criticised Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar and the government representatives for allegedly making derogatory remarks about government school teachers and blaming them for declining educational standards, while overlooking shortcomings in its own policies. She said the government was proposing that private institutions adopt three government schools each, with the provision to name the schools after the adopting institutions. Other proposals reportedly included deputing teachers from private schools and providing old buses, laboratory equipment and computers. The government should address deficiencies in public education and recruit adequate numbers of teachers instead of shifting its responsibility to private entities, she said. Ms. Meti alleged that 14 government schools had already been merged with the KPS at Hegganuru in Kanakapura, Bengaluru South district, contradicting the government’s assurance that no government school would be closed. She demanded the immediate withdrawal of the government’s education policies and called upon the public to join a movement against what she termed the “corporate takeover” of public education. AIDSO district president Sindhu Kou di, district organisers Shantesh Nandikollam, Siddalingappa Chippalakatti and Ravishankar Poladi, among others took part in the protest.
